title: Anigosha: Anime Quiz & Duels
shortDescription: Anime quiz with 800+ questions: play solo, win duels, climb the leaderboard.
fullDescription:
How well do you really know your series?

Anigosha is a quiz for anime fans: 804 hand-picked questions across
12 categories, each in three difficulty levels. From beginner knowledge
to details that trip up even seasoned viewers.

PLAY SOLO
Pick a category, pick a difficulty, start guessing. After every answer
you find out why it was right, so you take something away from each
round, including the ones you get wrong.

DUELS
Turn-based against others: four rounds of three questions, both players
get the same questions. You play when you have time, your opponent plays
when they do. A notification tells you when it is your turn.
While things are still quiet, computer opponents fill the gap. They are
marked as such in the app, and human players always take priority.

DAILY CHALLENGE
Five questions, new every day, the same for everyone. Plus its own daily
leaderboard, and a streak that grows as long as you keep at it.

LEVELS AND LEADERBOARD
Experience points for every round, an Elo rating for every duel, and a
global ranking for everyone. The 50:50 joker helps when you are torn
between two answers.

ALSO
- Five languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese
- Report incorrect questions, we fix them
- Share your results
- Ad-supported - a single one-time purchase removes the ads for good

No subscription. No hidden costs.
